title: Interleaving String
keyIdea: dp[i][j] = s1[0..i) and s2[0..j) can make s3[0..i + j). The last letter came from s1 (dp[i − 1][j] and s1[i − 1] == s3[i + j − 1]) or from s2 (dp[i][j − 1] and s2[j − 1] == s3[i + j − 1]). One row is enough.

approaches.name: One-row DP
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). Length check; dp over j for each i; fromS1 uses the old dp[j], fromS2 uses the new dp[j − 1].

quiz.q: Why does greedy (take from whichever string matches) fail?
options: Both strings can offer the same letter; the wrong pick fails later

quiz.q: In the one-row version, what is dp[j] before it is overwritten?
options: The row above: whether s1[0..i − 1) + s2[0..j) worked
